title: Take and compare aesthetic photos
summary: Today's photos per view, aligning them with the map and comparing progress against earlier sessions.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Tap the aesthetic session
steps.details: You can tell it by its status (Draft, In treatment, Ready to close, Closed…). Tapping it expands it. If the patient has none, create one first with Create → Aesthetic session.

steps.title: Continue session
steps.details: Resumes at the first step still missing. A closed or void session opens read-only.

steps.title: Today's photos
steps.details: Step 2. A photo of any view is enough; none is needed if the patient declined photos or if every mark is on the body.

steps.title: Views
steps.details: Front, left and right profile, each with today's photo and the earlier ones.

steps.title: Take photo
steps.details: Opens the camera with a framing guide and, if there is one, the last photo see-through to repeat pose, distance and light.

steps.title: Upload
steps.details: Choose images from the device, or drag them here.

steps.title: Photo of the view
steps.details: With a photo from today and an earlier one of the same view, this is where they're compared.

steps.title: Comparison mode
steps.details: Slider, side by side or overlaid with opacity. Below you can show each session's marks over the photo.

steps.title: Compare with the first one
steps.details: Goes back to the first session; any other can be chosen in the list of earlier ones.

steps.title: Earlier sessions
steps.details: The photos of this view in earlier sessions, with their date and how many days ago.

steps.title: Align
steps.details: Fits the photo to the map (eyes, nose, mouth) so the zones match when it is used as a background.

steps.title: Continue
steps.details: Goes to the treatment. Today's photo can also be used as a background for marking.
